svg.title: Extension host: components and dependencies
svg.desc: One composition root, one Hub UI, a harness core, and five pluggable capability layers.
svg.text: One composition root, one Hub UI, a harness core, and five pluggable capability layers.
Ctrl+Alt+A opens the Hub · Ctrl+Shift+A opens the command menu · 6 commands in the palette · no Alpaquitay server anywhere
activate() builds the services and injects them: SecretManager · PrivacyManager · AIProviderManager · MCPManager · SkillRegistry · SpecManager · GitIntegration. The
workspace root is validated first; without a writable root the Hub degrades to chat mode.
MainPanel — Hub (one WebviewPanel SPA, vanilla HTML/TS, no bundler)
